agents.name: Claude
agents.role: Lead agent and conductor. Default for anything that needs judgment, and the agent that merges council answers.
agents.notes: Claude Code / claude.ai hold your MCP connectors (Shopify, Klaviyo, Gmail, Slack, Drive, Calendar, Calendly, Bill.com, ThoughtMetric, Vibe, Konvert, Replit, Foresite, GitHub) and can drive the Macs. The API call from this hub has none of those, so connector and machine work is flagged as a hand-off.

agents.name: Perplexity
agents.role: Researcher. Live web search with cited sources.
agents.notes: Use when the answer depends on what is on the web today, or when you need sources you can click.

agents.name: ChatGPT
agents.role: Generalist and image maker. Second opinion on analysis and copy.
agents.notes: Image generation runs through ChatGPT or the Foresite generate-creative tool; this hub sends text prompts only.

agents.name: Grok
agents.role: Social listener. What is trending on X and how people are reacting.
agents.notes: Strongest where the question is about X/Twitter conversation, sentiment, or punchy social copy.

agents.name: Muse
agents.role: Meta's agent. Facebook, Instagram and Reels creative and audience ideas.
agents.notes: The hub talks to Muse's models through the Meta Model API. Background tasks in the Muse app (email, travel, purchases) still happen in the app itself.
